dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps this can be used to re-enter the mysterious, previously-inaccessible space.)

response.speaker: Book of Revealing
response.text: (The edges of the pages blur gradually. A profoundly unfamiliar yet familiar world enters your field of vision. Here...)

choices.text: (You put some distance between yourself and the Book of Revealing.)

response.speaker: Book of Revealing
response.text: (But the visions shown have already planted a seed within your heart.)
